_doc: BLARTZ'S OMEGA FORGE (docs/BS_WEAPONS.md §2.4-2.5). Requirements and price live in data/bs/weapons.json progression (omega_level 5, all mods at tier 3, a Signature Mod, omega_price 2000). Read by bs/forge/omega_forge.gd, ui/bs/forge_ui.gd and ForgeDebug. Lines under 'lines' (bs.forge.*) are voiced through WeaponText until VOManager.LINE_SOURCES lists ['bs/forge', 'lines'].

cutscene._doc: Evolution beats (§2.4): 1 the gun goes in, the door slams, Blartz cranks the bellows; 2 the window flares gold and the silhouette reshapes; 3 a gold Ω stamps on and the new name shows as a banner; 4 Blartz says the per-weapon line. Seconds per beat (about 8 s). Skippable after the first time.

bs.forge.blartz.01.text: Before you ask: yes, that's a forge. No, you can't afford it. Yes, you'll pay anyway.

bs.forge.blartz.02.text: When OmniScrap arrested me, they seized the prototype schematics. Every page. Even the doodles. ESPECIALLY the doodles.

bs.forge.blartz.03.text: So why is there a forge bolted to your kiosk?

bs.forge.blartz.04.text: I re-built this one from memory, which is better than the original, which was also perfect.

bs.forge.blartz.05.text: Bring me a weapon at V5 with every mod installed, plus two thousand bolts. I'll teach it things its manufacturer never did. The manufacturer was me. I was holding back.

bs.forge.blartz.06.text: And then what happens to it?

bs.forge.blartz.07.text: It EVOLVES. Gold Omega, new name, new tricks, a very small amount of screaming. From the weapon. Mostly.

bs.forge.blartz.08.text: And the patent is PENDING. B-L-Z, four-oh-four-one-seven. If you ever see this design anywhere else in the universe, call me. Then call a lawyer. Then call me back so I can gloat.

bs.forge.blartz.09.text: Where else would it show up?

bs.forge.blartz.10.text: Nowhere! The schematics are in an OmniScrap vault, and OmniScrap is about to stop existing. What's the worst that can happen to confiscated paperwork in a fire sale?

bs.forge.blartz.11.text: I'm writing that down. For later. For a reason.

bs.forge.deny.01.text: That weapon is a CHILD. Use it until it's seen things. Then bring it back.

bs.forge.deny.02.text: You want me to evolve a gun with EMPTY MOD SLOTS? That's like icing a cake you haven't baked. Buy the mods.

bs.forge.deny.03.text: It has no signature. Every masterpiece needs a signature. Mine is on the invoice.

bs.forge.deny.04.text: Two thousand. Not 'around' two thousand. Not 'emotionally' two thousand. TWO. THOUSAND.

bs.forge.evolve.blaster.text: OVERTIME. It works late, it never asks for a raise, and it sets things on fire. Ideal employee.

bs.forge.evolve.void.text: SECOND OPINION. Hits once, thinks about it, hits again. Very thorough. Very medical.

bs.forge.evolve.zap.text: FULL CHARGE. Your robot is now legally a power station. Don't tell the utility board.

bs.forge.evolve.boom.text: HEADLINER! Bigger floor, bigger drop, and the crowd pays double. That's showbiz.

bs.forge.evolve.dart.text: DOUBLE FAULT. Two darts, two targets, zero sportsmanship.

bs.forge.evolve.patent.text: ...It's GRANTED. My patent is GRANTED. Somebody get me a frame. And a tissue. A frame first.

bs.forge.evolve.cease.text: INJUNCTION. Now they can't even fight back while they read it. Legally that's called 'winning'.

bs.forge.evolve.buzz.text: MOOD KILLER. Five bounces, and every blade has a twin. A very angry twin.

bs.forge.evolve.grav.text: EVENT HORIZON. Physics filed a complaint. I filed it under 'later'.

bs.forge.evolve.mid.text: MIDDLE MANAGEMENT. Two of them now. They've already scheduled a meeting about each other.

bs.forge.evolve.frost.text: DEEP FREEZE. Nine seconds of ice. Put a hat on the statue. Sell it as art.

bs.forge.evolve.root.text: ORTHODONTIST. Five gardens, faster chewing, and the bill arrives in installments.

bs.forge.evolve.latefee.text: COMPOUND INTEREST. The longer you wait, the more it hurts them. Just like a real bank!

bs.forge.evolve.fineprint.text: TERMS APPLY. Nobody reads them. That's what makes them so EFFECTIVE.

bs.forge.evolve.hostile.text: GOLDEN PARACHUTE. When the contract ends, they leave rich. In the sense that they explode into money.

bs.forge.evolve.clearance.text: EVERYTHING MUST GO. Including their armour. Including their dignity. Final sale!

bs.forge.plaque.text: BLARTZ'S OMEGA FORGE · MOD. Ω-1 · PAT. PEND. BLZ-40417

bs.forge.ui.locked.text: The Forge is cold. Its owner is currently unavailable for comment.

bs.forge.ui.req.text: Needs V5, every mod at tier 3, a Signature Mod and %d bolts.
